The explicit sine eigenbasis establishes both *optimal* frame bounds and the critical quadratic law. The exact-rational checker independently tests overlap identities and finite grids, without substituting computation for the all-real proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete spectral law for the canonical Haar wavelet with translation matched to its half-support: all real modulations, sharp reconstruction constants, infinitely many jump thresholds and a universal quadratic approach to critical density. It is structurally more informative than mere frame/nonframe status and can guide deterministic conditioning; no wider frame-set classification is needed for its value.
